prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. PRODUCTION REFERENCE SHEET, landscape, not a finished book page. Bold clean clear 2D children's cartoon throughout, crisp continuous dark outlines, flat clean colors, restrained smooth cel shading, no painted or grainy texture, no gouache, no embossed relief, no 3D. Original friendly readable illustration. Ordinary neutral settings; no flags, religious/political symbols or costumes. No logos, text, letters, numbers, pseudo-writing, captions, watermarks or page borders. Natural anatomy and coherent hand/prop contact. Essential content at least 8 percent inside every edge.
 No named child cast: Kit and Zoe MUST NOT appear. Include unnamed human workers/adults ONLY when explicitly required by this particular scene; otherwise show only the natural subjects. Preserve exact reference identity and clothing.
Book: From Cotton to Shirt; World Discovery; nonfiction.
Setting: One illustrative woven cotton shirt: plain pale blue, short sleeves, pointed collar and four white front buttons. This is a woven garment, not a knitted T-shirt. Modern machinery guarded; adults operate it, no children on factory floor.
Design locks for the book's recurring subjects/props (NOT a visibility list; never insert later objects/states prematurely): Mature cotton bolls with fibers around seeds; Cotton fiber, yarn and plain-weave cloth; Same pale-blue short-sleeved button-front shirt
 Create a clean separated reference board on white: show the principal recurring props/animals in front, side and three-quarter views, their relative scale beside any named human cast, and a single simple location key showing the persistent setting and daylight/palette. The human character model sheet is a supporting identity reference, not content to copy wholesale. Show only the subjects this book requires. Use initial object states: Recognizable dry boll segments; no wool, feathers or cloth growing from the plant.. For orientation, the opening location/action is: An open cotton boll reveals white fibers around dark seeds. Recognizable dry boll segments; no wool, feathers or cloth growing from the plant.. Do not show a completed craft or later scene merely because the finished object is listed in design locks. No future story events, no captions. Reference-sheet override: any lettering requested by the opening page brief belongs only in that finished page. Keep this production reference board entirely unlabelled; no letters, numbers or pseudo-writing. Draw all surfaces with perfectly smooth solid vector-like color fills. No speckle, grain, watercolor, paper texture or 3D shading. Show ONLY this book’s explicitly named subjects and props, with anatomically correct shapes and physically connected parts. No extra animals, humans or decorative objects. Each diagram must reflect actual mechanisms; avoid fantasy decorative arrows.

visualReview.note: Cotton boll/seed/fiber designs, perpendicular plain-weave model, guarded factory, adult workers and pale-blue short-sleeved shirt established. Front and three-quarter shirt views each have four white buttons; pointed collar and pale-blue fabric consistent. No lettering.
visualReview.limits: Reference design only. Final page-specific sequence, weaving alternation and guarded machinery remain direct-review requirements.
